itemdesc-exoskeletonchest: A powered frame worn over the torso, using temporal gears as fuel. Designed to aid laborers and miners in dangerous environments.
fuelable-nofuel: Out of fuel. Right-click a temporal gear onto it to refuel.
exoskeleton-effect-mining: While powered: +{0}% mining speed on all materials
exoskeleton-effect-stability: While powered: temporal stability does not drain
exoskeleton-effect-damage: Taking damage while powered drains {0:0.#} hours of fuel per HP
ingameerror-fuelable-full: This item's fuel is already full
itemdesc-springboots: Advanced shock absorbing mechanical boots that use temporal gears as fuel. The millwrights and carpenters of the kingdom rejoiced at the invention of such technology.
springboots-effect-charge: Hold crouch to charge a jump ({0}x). Charge is held for {1:0.#} seconds
springboots-effect-fall: While powered: immune to fall damage ({0:0.#} hours of fuel per HP absorbed)
itemdesc-shockabsorptionapparatus: A component for the Jonas Springboots. Capable of absorbing and releasing tremendous amounts of force.
itemdesc-springbootsbody: A component for the Jonas Springboots. A sturdy yet flexible frame made from cupronickel and steel.
blockdesc-jonasworkbench-*: A sturdy bench for assembling Jonas devices. Place a blueprint on it, then install the parts it calls for.
itemdesc-jonasblueprint-springboots: Assembly instructions for the Jonas Springboots. Place on a Jonas Workbench to begin construction.
itemdesc-jonasblueprint-exoskeleton: Assembly instructions for the Jonas Exoskeleton. Place on a Jonas Workbench to begin construction.
itemdesc-jonasblueprint-*: Assembly instructions for a Jonas part, copied from a found original. Place on a Jonas Workbench to begin construction.
itemdesc-exoskeletontorsoframe: A component for the Jonas Exoskeleton. The steel spine and power core that carry the frame.
itemdesc-exoskeletonarmframe: A component for the Jonas Exoskeleton. A geared steel limb that lends its strength to the wearer's arm.
workbench-needhammer: Hold a hammer in your main hand to assemble
blockdesc-temporalaccelfield: Burns temporal gears to make time run faster in the space around it. Affects campfires, barrels, pit kilns, bloomeries, and item aging.
accelfield-info-inactive: Inactive. Add temporal gears to power it.
itemdesc-portableresonator-*: A portable version of the standard resonator. Only the most wealthy nobles possessed such a device of luxury.
heldhelp-resonator-open: Insert or remove a tuning cylinder
ingameerror-resonator-nocylinder: No tuning cylinder loaded. Right-click to insert one
